notes: NJMEA seats two high school All-State choruses from one spring audition cycle: the All-State Mixed Chorus, which rehearses in the fall and performs in November, and the All-State Treble Chorus, which rehearses in winter and performs in February. NJMEA's announcement reads '2026-2027 All-State Chorus materials will be open Monday, February 23rd - Friday, April 3rd'; February 23 falls on a Monday and April 3 on a Friday in 2026, so that window is Feb 23 - Apr 3, 2026, and it feeds the 2026-27 ensembles whose rehearsal and concert dates on the NJMEA calendar are Sept-Nov 2026 (Mixed) and Jan-Feb 2027 (Treble). Detailed audition requirements (scales, solo, quintet, ranges, rubric) live behind TheDirectorsRoom.com, which requires a director login, so they are not captured here. NJMEA's public chorus landing page was still headed '2025-2026 All-State Chorus Information' at retrieval; only the auditions page carried 2026-2027 content. Elementary and junior high All-State choirs are run by NJACDA, not NJMEA.

organization.name: New Jersey Music Educators Association
organization.description: NJMEA, at 300 W. Somerdale Rd., Suite C, Voorhees, NJ 08043, administers New Jersey's All-State Band, Chorus, Orchestra, and (with NJAJE) Jazz ensembles, plus a state conference and a range of festivals. The All-State Chorus program is led by a Choral Performance Chair and a Choral Procedures Chair; elementary and junior high All-State choirs are handled by the affiliated New Jersey ACDA.

programs.name: NJMEA All-State Mixed Chorus
programs.description: New Jersey's high school All-State Mixed Chorus. Auditions are recorded and submitted online through TheDirectorsRoom.com during a spring window; selected students rehearse across the fall and perform jointly with the All-State Orchestra in November. Managed by the All-State Choir Managers with a Choral Performance Chair and Choral Procedures Chair.

requirements.title: Only NJMEA-provided accompaniment tracks may be used
requirements.description: NJMEA states it is critically important that all students and teachers use ONLY the tracks provided in TheDirectorsRoom and the StudentFolder for all recordings. The Silver Swan tracks were updated for the '26-27 season. Use of any other tracks results in an automatic score of '9's' — no exceptions.

requirements.title: Audition documents and registration
requirements.description: Students and teachers must review all documents provided in both the shared online Google Drive folder and TheDirectorsRoom.com. Registration and audition upload are managed through TheDirectorsRoom by an Online Registration Manager; questions about the audition process go to the Choral Procedures Chair.
